readings: Join appearances to player on player_id, dropping appearances with no matching player. Group by the player's bats value and treat players whose bats is NULL as their own group. For each group, including the NULL one, give the appearance count, the count as a share of all matched appearances, and the count divided by the average count across all groups, including the NULL group. Leave the numbers unrounded.

Join appearances to player on player_id, dropping appearances with no matching player. Also drop appearances whose player has a NULL bats value, so only the recorded batting hands (L, R, B) remain. For each of these hands, give the appearance count, the count as a share of the total across only these hands, and the count divided by the average count across only these hands. Leave the numbers unrounded.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       cnt AS appearance_count,
       CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share_of_total,
       CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM g) AS ratio_to_average
FROM g;
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM appearances a
    JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       cnt,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share_of_total,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM counts) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM counts;
